resolved_findings.description: Initial independent Clang UBSan run found pool_memory+physical_address-base pointer formation before integer subtraction in fixture lines47–49. Author fixed parenthesized integer offsets before freeze; corrected frozen actual-owner session now passes Clang ASan/UBSan failfast. No native source defect inferred.

reviewed: Exact native object/current worker/active/nonparked identity and retained CAP/BASIC/FW_READY receipts remain admission prerequisites; recipe or plain clone does not grant native access.

Lease checks support COMMAND/WRITING/SUBMITTED/SERVICE transitions while preserving exact cursor, wire fingerprint, sequence, ring indices and acquired/released/reserved accounting. No callback occurs in the commit gap; terminal DONE closes admission.

Successful AXI publication releases this command software PSE reservation per selected hal_pdma.c2587–2596; BASICspent1 remains debited. Failed/uncertain publication keeps reservation and halts, never invents firmware credit/ACK.

Completion requires expected DIDX then actual owned descriptor DDONE per source hal_pdma.c2332–2360; returned descriptor fields are captured opaque under this source-aligned new normal transport contract. No echo assertion or firmware acceptance is fabricated.

Pump uses exact checked access object/session with bounded16-event passes and hard batch/command deadlines. Soft service deadline is tested between complete passes to avoid terminating a rearm solely at the soft cutoff.
Callbacks failure propagates session/init/transport and native shared halt. Actual worker tail retains30s scheduler-only drain/manual-reset panic. Scheduler sleeps do not perform USB/MMIO recovery.

SERVICE timeout/event-budget exhaustion returns a truthful partial lease closure with scan_complete0, no scan cancellation/ACK claim. Mappings remain retained and parked; full scan success must require actual matching completion in root coordinator.

independent_validation.method: Compiled and executed frozen tests/test-session.c with actual proposed binding and canonical callback sources in TemporaryDirectory; no author output file changed.
